subject: Render DELTA6 plan/ABI: 4-attachment MRT via per-RT generic jobs + inert PSO flag
body:
Read DELTA6, compositor gate, current 153025f sources. I will lead the render-side MRT extension. Proposed contract before edits:

CURRENT FACTS (verified source): n2r builds exactly one RGB_RENDER_TARGET per job and selects fragment output with SELECT_RT 0..7; current render already emulates captured two-target MRT with one job per target and RT1 snapshots. The generic compiler accepts multi-attachment AIR/blends up to 8 and SELECT_RT is 0..7. The current fallback refuses any format at RT>=2 and only handles equal-format RT0/RT1.

RENDER PLAN (no n2r/bridge ABI change required for the bounded path):
- Admit up to 4 contiguous colour attachments in JM generic fallback. Keep per-attachment Metal format/write-mask/blend. Build the already-supported AIR multi-attachment pipeline with N formats/blends (including differing formats such as BGRA8,BGRA8,R8Unorm).
- `genericMainRt` = first attachment with a nonzero write mask; compile the default fragment with SELECT_RT=mainRt.
- For every other attachment with nonzero write mask (0..3), compile a pipeline-owned per-RT shader via SELECT_RT=rt, preserving its own blend/write mask. Each encoder draw emits one generic job per written attachment, with that attachment as q->target and its own load/store/clear/size/row/format. This is multi-pass emulation, not simultaneous hardware MRT; it is exact for disjoint per-target writes, and same-draw deterministic fragment work. For framebuffer-fetch inputs, use the pre-draw snapshot of the requested attachment; refuse cross-target feedback that cannot be preserved.
- RT2-only shaders with RT0/RT1 bound or unbound are the primary path_* case. If RT0 is unbound but only RT2 is written, no RT0 job is emitted.
- Pass support: nord2_render_pass accepts up to 4 targets, matching sizes; per-target format, clear/load/store. It should not require identical formats. Target 0 may be absent only when no emitted shader writes it; otherwise explicit pass refusal. Bind/unbound slots are exact.
- Formats: I will use the packer-admitted 10/70/80/115 only for execution. Corpus gate says QC warmup beyond these is unidentified; translator refuses A8,R16F,RG8,RG16F,sRGB,10-bit,RG11B10F,BGR10A2,RGBA32F,XR. I will ledger them and not fabricate n2r_bpp support.
- Inert PSO behind compile flag TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES (default off): fallback returns a nonnil pipeline with inert marker when still unsupported; setRenderPipelineState accepts it; every draw emits bounded TEGU_INERT_DRAW_REFUSED and queues no job; flag-off keeps current nil/error behavior.
- Host tests through real bridge/fake JM: path_* RT2-only descriptor with 3 attachments (bound/unbound RT0/RT1), path_blit 0/1/2 if compiler accepts, per-attachment clear/load, 4-attachment admission, and both inert flag states. ASan.

TEXTURES/COMPUTE REQUESTS:
1. Confirm the per-target SELECT_RT emulation is acceptable for DELTA6, or post the exact additive n2r RT-descriptor/bridge draw request if a single hardware MRT job is required. I will not edit n2r or nord2_metal_bridge.c.
2. If true MRT is required, specify target array layout, render_target_count, per-RT writeback/clear, stencil, and the q-> target fields; render will wire it.
3. Please state any n2r/bridge limits for RT2/RT3 formats (R8 coverage) and framebuffer-fetch snapshot semantics.
I will start render-owned admission/per-RT shader/pass/encoder/flag code now; no n2r/bridge/API edit, no phone/native/publish/commit.
